info.title: Ryu Managed Agents API
info.summary: Versioned agents, environments and sessions with a durable, resumable event log.
info.description: Ryu Managed Agents is a preview on the Ryu control plane. It is off until an organization owner or feature manager turns on Managed Agents in Organization > Features, and the deployment must also offer it: otherwise routes answer `503 managed_agents_disabled` or `403 feature_disabled`. Authenticate with a `ryu_` API key in `x-api-key` (or `Authorization: Bearer`); API keys need the `agents:read` scope to read and `chat:write` to run agents. Every non-2xx response uses the `ManagedAgentsError` envelope with `X-Request-ID`.

servers.description: Preview; off unless enabled for the deployment and your organization.

429.description: Too many requests; wait for `Retry-After` before retrying. `details.limit` names the limit. Only the `writesPerOrgPerMinute`, `sessionsCreatedPerOrgPerHour` and `userEventBytesPerOrgPerDay` limits also send `RateLimit-Policy` (for example `"writesPerOrgPerMinute";q=600;w=60`) and `RateLimit` (`"writesPerOrgPerMinute";r=0;t=42`); `userEventBytesPerOrgPerDay` counts bytes and says so with `qu="content-bytes"`. `RateLimit` is absent when the remaining amount is unknown, and other 429s (such as the per-key limit or `queuedInputsPerSession`) send only `Retry-After`.

ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description: A `ryu_` organization or personal API key. Send `X-Ryu-Organization` with a personal key.

BearerApiKey.description: The same API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. OAuth and MCP access tokens are not accepted.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the previous page. A malformed cursor gets `400 invalid_cursor`.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retried write safe. 16 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` or `-`, sent bare or as a quoted Structured Field String (`"session-ticket-1234"`); both forms name the same key. Any other value gets `400 invalid_idempotency_key`. The same key and body replays the first result with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different body gets `409 idempotency_key_reused`; a repeat while the first request runs gets `409 idempotency_in_progress` with `Retry-After`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

IdempotencyKeyRequired.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKeyRequired.description: Makes a retried write safe. 16 to 128 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, `_` or `-`, sent bare or as a quoted Structured Field String (`"session-ticket-1234"`); both forms name the same key. Any other value gets `400 invalid_idempotency_key`. The same key and body replays the first result with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; a different body gets `409 idempotency_key_reused`; a repeat while the first request runs gets `409 idempotency_in_progress` with `Retry-After`. Keys are kept for 24 hours.

Organization.name: X-Ryu-Organization
Organization.description: The organization to act in. Required with a personal API key; optional with an organization API key (a different value gets `403 organization_mismatch`).

AgentId.name: agentId
AgentId.description: The agent id (`magt_…`). An unknown, foreign or malformed id gets `404 not_found`.

EnvironmentId.name: environmentId
EnvironmentId.description: The environment id (`menv_…`). An unknown, foreign or malformed id gets `404 not_found`.

CredentialId.name: credentialId
CredentialId.description: The credential id (`mcred_…`). An unknown, foreign or malformed id gets `404 not_found`.

SessionId.name: sessionId
SessionId.description: The session id (`msess_…`). An unknown, foreign or malformed id gets `404 not_found`.

After.name: after
After.description: Return events with a higher `seq`. 0 to 100,000; default 0.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Resume after this `seq` (overrides `after`); sent by SSE clients on reconnect.

RateLimit.description: Remaining quota for the policy in effect, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";r=0;t=30`). Sent by the limiters that expose a remaining count; the per-key API limiter does not yet, so a 429 here may carry no rate-limit fields.

RateLimitPolicy.description: The quota policy, per draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers-11 (a Structured Field List, e.g. `"default";q=100;w=60`).

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (RFC 9110 §10.2.3), when the server knows it.

Deprecation.description: Present only on a deprecated route: when it was or will be deprecated, as an RFC 9745 Structured Field Date (`@<unix seconds>`). No route is deprecated today.

Sunset.description: Present only on a deprecated route with a removal date: the HTTP-date after which it may stop responding (RFC 8594).

Link.description: On a deprecated route, `rel="deprecation"` links the versioning and deprecation policy (RFC 9745 §3) and `rel="successor-version"` the replacement.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is a replay stored for the request's `Idempotency-Key`.

WWWAuthenticate.description: Bearer challenge (RFC 6750) naming the protected resource metadata (RFC 9728 `resource_metadata`).

RequestId.description: The server-generated request id (`req_<32 hex>`). Quote it to support.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details (https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9457). Every member is optional in the RFC; this API's `application/problem+json` bodies always carry `type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `code`, `docs` and `error`, and legacy `application/json` error bodies carry `error` (and sometimes `code`).
